passage:
10:30 pm, Sunday. I finally did it: left the "Terrace Gang" chat. It had 300 messages a day, and my thesis chapter was suffering. But I did not want to slip out silently and have everyone wonder if I was upset.
So I wrote to Ojas, the admin, first: "Hey, I'm stepping back from the group till March to focus on my thesis. Nothing is wrong, I love you all. Ping me directly anytime." Then I left.
Ojas answered within a minute: "Understood! Good luck, we'll miss your memes ❤️" A few friends messaged me alone too. I feel light. And still wanted.
— Sarita

qa.q: What did Sarita write to Ojas before leaving the group?
qa.a: Sarita wrote that they were stepping back from the group till March to focus on their thesis, and that nothing was wrong.

qa.q: What was Sarita feeling about leaving the group at 10:30 pm?
qa.a: Sarita felt relieved and a little anxious about how it would look. Writing to Ojas first shows the wish not to hurt anyone.

qa.q: What did Sarita do that made leaving gentler than slipping out silently?
qa.a: Sarita wrote to the admin first, explaining the reason and saying nothing was wrong. Inviting friends to ping directly kept the friendships open.

qa.q: How might Ojas have felt to get the message before Sarita left?
qa.a: Ojas probably felt reassured and warm, since the reply came within a minute and mentioned missing Sarita's memes. Knowing it was not an insult made it easy to accept.

grounding: A person leaves a noisy group after telling the admin they are stepping back for focus, so it does not seem like an insult.

passage:
Group chat "Batch of 2019", Wednesday night
Jahnavi: Pradeep, you've been quiet, everything ok?
Pradeep: All fine 🙂 Just muting the group for a few weeks. Too many notifications while I prepare for my exam.
Jahnavi: Ah, got it. Leaving already?
Pradeep: Not leaving! Just muted. If something is urgent, tag me or call me.
Jahnavi: Perfect. Will tag you for the reunion plan 😄
Pradeep: Please do. I didn't want to just vanish and have you all wondering.
Jahnavi: Appreciated. Honestly, I thought you were upset with someone.
Pradeep: Not at all. Miss you all. Back in March, with snacks.
Jahnavi: Deal. Good luck with the exam!

qa.q: What reason did Pradeep give for muting the group?
qa.a: Pradeep said there were too many notifications while preparing for an exam.

qa.q: What was Jahnavi worried about when asking whether Pradeep was leaving?
qa.a: Jahnavi was worried that Pradeep might be upset or drifting away. The question "Leaving already?" shows the concern.

qa.q: What did Pradeep say that kept the friendship comfortable while muting?
qa.a: Pradeep said the group was only muted, not left, and asked to be tagged or called if something was urgent. The note "Back in March" kept the door open.

qa.q: How might Pradeep feel about the group while muting it?
qa.a: Still fond of everyone, since Pradeep says 'Miss you all', promises to be back in March with snacks and did not want to just vanish.

grounding: A person who wants out of a noisy group mutes it and tells the admin they are stepping back for focus, easing any hurt.
